entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand tracker. I've had it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a piece of junk! That's the issue! It doesn't do what I want and I don't want it anymore. I want my money back. Now.
Okay, I can certainly look into the return options for you. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
The name is Mike Schmidt. I don't have the order number, you should be able to find it. I got it for Christmas, so it's been over a month. Don't try to give me some runaround about a time limit.
I understand your frustration, Mike. Let me just pull up your account. One moment... Okay, I see it here. The VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th.
See? So are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager? This is ridiculous. Your website promises satisfaction.
There's no need for that, sir. I've just checked our return policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for the VeloBand GPS Tracker.
Wait, what? You're not going to fight me on this? I've had it for like, 44 days.
No, sir. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. You are perfectly eligible for a full refund. I can start that process for you right now and email you a pre-paid return label.
Oh. Well... yeah. Okay. That's... that's good. A full refund, you said?

Yes, a full refund to the original payment method once we receive the item. I've just sent the return shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
You're very welcome, Mike. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
